user_correction: Series, not parallel. Image shows motor -> vortex.
mode: Built-in imagegen generation plus targeted edit
status: Pressure-budget concept only, not fitted CAD or qualified installation.
flow_path: Scuba -> first stage -> secondary pressure protection/regulator -> pulse valve -> AM0701 -> approved pressurized exhaust collector -> interstage line -> vortex SIDE inlet -> cold nozzle, with separate vortex hot exhaust. Shaft drives separate guarded friction brake.
governing_constraints: Motor and vortex mass flows must match at an actual coupled operating point.
Final cold mass flow = vortex cold fraction * motor flow; hot stream rejects the rest.
Previous 671 W / 15 g/s and ambient-exhaust thermal screen does not apply to pressurized motor exhaust.
Motor exhaust backpressure limit and pressurized collection are unverified.
Do not raise motor inlet beyond its actual nameplate/manual rating.

ideal_reference.status: Ideal-gas reversible adiabatic comparison at fixed illustrative flow; not an AM0701 prediction or a Jeanoko requirement.

primary_source.exair_cold_backpressure_notes: FAQ says up to 2 psig causes no change and 5 psig affects cooling; restrictions above 5 psig are discouraged.
primary_source.transfer_limit: EXAIR reference only. Jeanoko exact pressure/flow/backpressure curves are unknown.

reverse_order: Vortex -> motor requires backpressure at the vortex cold outlet to drive the motor; ordinary vortex performance is sensitive to that backpressure. No qualified reverse series point identified.
decision: Do not treat this as a drop-in improvement. Need motor loaded flow/work/backpressure map and exact vortex inlet/cold-fraction curves before recommendation.
validation: Arithmetic ideal benchmark only. No new CFD, Lean proof or hardware validation.
